messages:
maria_cs: FYI — Nebula Health renewal in ~3 weeks, account health dipped. Proposing two enablement sessions this week to mitigate renewal risk: (A) 45m office hours (Q&A) and (B) 90m platform deep-dive workshop with migration playbook. Need timezone coverage, facilitator, recording, and owners for action items.

leo_se: I can run the deep-dive Wed/Thu. Prefer to pair with Anita for hands-on bits. Which days are we thinking?

anita_enable: I can facilitate the office hours and co-facilitate the workshop. Will need the slide deck, sample prompts, and any eval results from the account.

sophie_ops: I can poll for slots — please react with :one: :two: :three: to vote. I will consolidate and book invites.

maria_cs: Proposed slots (local times):
```
1) Tue 09:00 PT / 17:00 GMT / Tue 01:00 AEST — Office Hours (45m)
2) Wed 11:00 PT / 19:00 GMT / Thu 05:00 AEST — Workshop (90m)
3) Thu 22:00 PT / Fri 06:00 GMT / Fri 16:00 AEST — APAC-friendly Workshop (90m)
```
React with 1/2/3. Feel free to react to multiple if you can cover/changeover. :calendar: 

raj_ae: I'll loop in the Nebula contacts (tech lead + PM). FYI renewal flags: drop in token usage and questions about latency routing. Can we add a 15m slot on latency diagnostics + routing policy?

anita_enable: Good call — adding to the workshop agenda. Draft agenda: 5m intros; 15m health summary + renewal signals; 20m routing & latency tuning (Leo); 30m hands-on: prompt sets + evals; 10m next steps/action owners. We should capture owners in the notes doc.

leo_se: I'll prep latency slides and a short diagnostics checklist. Maria — can you grant me view access to Nebula logs/S3? Need to show a real example during the workshop.

maria_cs: Shared S3 link in DM. I'll attach a sample prompt set to the invite after slots are confirmed.

sophie_ops: I'll enable recording on the calendar invite and create a notes doc. Also can make a 3-question feedback form to send post-session.

deploy-bot: Reminder: calendar invite should be titled "Redwood Enablement — Nebula Health" and RSVP required.

maria_cs: Thanks everyone. If no objections I'll book the top-reacted slot and send invites + prework by EOD. Ping me if you want a prep run or slides review. :pray:
